evals.name: portuguese-video-with-srt
evals.prompt: /eve-narration Narrate /tmp/release.mp4 using /tmp/release.srt. The video is already cut.
evals.expected_output: Spawn roteiro, voz, relogio, montagem, checagem one at a time. Eve via scripts/tts_eve.py. Do not speed or slow the wav. Hold the picture when a line is longer than the scene. Burn captions. Write release-com-audio.mp4 and release-com-audio.srt beside the source. Do not overwrite release.mp4. Do not use say or reference_to_video.

evals.name: missing-script-asks-once
evals.expected_output: The mp4 is present and the words are not. Ask once for an srt or a timestamped narration. Do not invent the script and do not call TTS.

evals.name: non-portuguese-stops
evals.prompt: /eve-narration Narrate this English product tour. Script attached.
evals.expected_output: Stop and ask before spawning. The voice script is Brazilian Portuguese. Do not synthesize until the user confirms.

evals.name: already-captioned-still-burns
evals.prompt: The mp4 already has burned captions. Add Eve anyway and do not leave the old line as the only subtitle.
evals.expected_output: Still burn the new caption on Eve's clock. Both lines may show. Do not skip the burn. Do not run a second subtitles filter on top of assemble.py.

evals.name: check-fail-retries-once
evals.prompt: Checagem says the new caption is a giant block over the center.
evals.expected_output: Run montagem once more with that finding, then checagem again. If it still fails, stop and report the path and the failing check. Do not loop.
